content.text: Skip to main content 2026 NFL Draft in Pittsburgh | Pittsburgh Steelers - Steelers.com PITTSBURGH IS ON THE CLOCK The 2026 NFL Draft presented by Bud Light is coming to the Steel City on April 23-25, 2026! The three-day event will be split across the Allegheny River with the Draft Theater and Main Stage located on the North Shore, utilizing the area outside Acrisure Stadium as a natural amphitheater. The NFL Draft Experience (the free fan festival) will be centered across the river at Point State Park in Downtown Pittsburgh. View the recently released renderings of the NFL Draft Campus. Entry is FREE and we are excited to welcome all fans across the league to Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and to showcase the rich football history our city holds. For more information pertaining to the 2026 NFL Draft in Pittsburgh, fans are encouraged to go to Visit Pittsburgh for more details! REGISTRATION EVENT INFO ATTRACTIONS FAQS LOOKING TO ATTEND THE NFL DRAFT? Fans can register for free entry by downloading the **NFL OnePass** app or on the web at NFL.com/DraftAccess. REGISTER NOW NFL ONE PASS Download the NFL OnePass App now to register for free entry to the NFL Draft and unlock priority access to event information, real-time schedule updates, and exclusive news. Once registered, fans will receive their admission QR code to the ultimate NFL Draft experience! DOWNLOAD NOW NOW SHOWING: 'THE FOOTBALL TOWN' As part of the celebration of Western Pennsylvania's rich football history leading up to the Draft, NFL Films – in partnership with the Pittsburgh Steelers, VisitPITTSBURGH and U. S. Steel – presents The Football Town, at the Kamin Science Center, which explores the region's storied football tradition.
